_readme: Escape hatch for the CI schema-drift gate (DEC-045, scripts/check-schema.mjs).
A gate that blocks deploys on false positives is worse than the disease, so
suppressions live here — committed, so every suppression is visible in the
diff and greppable, rather than hidden behind an env var or a CLI flag.
Every entry MUST carry a reason and the ticket that added it. The gate
reports entries that no longer suppress anything as stale, so this file
tables[]  : { name, reason, addedBy } — a table the live schema legitimately
lacks (e.g. created outside the migration set, or referenced
only on a code path that is dead in this environment).
embeds[]  : { from, select, reason, addedBy } — an exact (table, select-string)
pair whose relationship the live schema legitimately lacks.
dynamicFromBaseline : how many non-literal .from() calls on a Supabase client
are tolerated. A dynamic table name cannot be probed, so it is an
unchecked hole in the gate. Baseline is 0 — all 13 non-literal
.from() sites in this codebase are Array.from / Buffer.from /
